coverage: All u16 selected-slot values, enabled/disabled skip flag, evolution/no evolution, egg/non-egg and held item NONE/first mail/last mail. Valid swaps preserve complete controlled mon payloads, adjust non-egg friendship to 70, set seen/caught with incoming species/personality, buffer incoming nickname and leave other party slots unchanged. Rejected swaps leave parties, text and dex unchanged and clear LASTRESULT.
findings: No swap or rejection defect found in this controlled scope.
limitations: Controlled surrogate Pokemon layout and mocked GetMonData/SetMonData, evolution, flag and dex APIs. Actual encrypted mon data, all interior mail IDs, evolution API behavior, script sequencing and linked GBA scene parity remain unverified.
